body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News> Clipcomm(www.clipcomm.co.kr) presented its analog telephone adapter ‘BS-H100’ during CES 2008, which allows normal telephone to use Bluetooth headset.
With the BS-H100, you can enjoy Bluetooth headset on normal telephones installed at home and office. The BS-H100 features moderate price and simple design.
< AVING Special Report Team for ‘CES 2008’: Publisher and Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Rose Kim, Alliyah Seo, Joshua Shim, Li Coffee, Brain Park >
